  PROBLEM: A verified resolution head gets the `merge_resolve_audit` carry and the override `delta_source="$(printf '%s\t\tclean\t' "${single_pass_remerge_since}")"`, which dispatches `audit_diff_since=<from>`. scripts/security_audit.sh (lines 925-946) then keeps only the intersection of merge-base..head files and from..head files. A file that the resolution restored to first-parent (`from`) content is in `git show --remerge-diff` but not in from..head, so it is silently dropped from the audit. The comment added at 1354-1359, which claims the scope "covers every file the remerge diff touches (a fail-safe superset)", is false.
  WHY: A resolution that discards a base-tip change, such as a security fix that landed on main, is audited nowhere and can be marked clean. Before this PR the head got a full merge-base..head audit. This breaks the issue's "fail closed toward a full review" constraint, and the input_mismatch re-check (lines 1531-1542) compares only marker identity, not file scope. Four reviewers rated it MAJOR; google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite stated no severity.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  PROBLEM: The comment is wrong. scripts/security_audit.sh lines 937-946 keep only PR-range files that are also in `${AUDIT_SCOPE_SINCE_SHA}..${AUDIT_SCOPE_HEAD_SHA}` (`grep -Fxf`). A file that the resolver writes at the approved head's version (ours-kept conflict or reverted clean base change) is missing from from..head, yet it appears in `git show --remerge-diff <head>` and in the PR range, so it is dropped from the audit.
  WHY: A resolver commit that silently drops a main-branch security fix gets `merge_resolve_audit`, which also skips the inheritance walk at line 1149, and gets a delta audit without the file. Before this PR the head had a full merge-base..head audit. The input_mismatch re-check at lines 1531-1542 compares only marker identity. Suggested fix: in the clean branch, compare the remerge-diff file list with from..head using `comm -23`, and fall through to freshness_unverified on any missing file, git failure, or git < 2.36. Also correct the comment.
